question: What is the height of Mahendragiri which is the highest peak in the Eastern Ghats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1501 meters**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahendragiri** is the highest peak in the **Eastern Ghats**.
 
• It is located in the **Gajapati district of Odisha**, India.
 
• The peak rises to an elevation of **1501 meters** above sea level.
 
• The **Eastern Ghats** are a discontinuous range of mountains along India's eastern coast.
 
• Mahendragiri is considered a **significant peak** due to its religious and mythological importance.
 
• The area around Mahendragiri is known for its **rich biodiversity** and unique flora and fauna.
 
• The peak is also associated with **Hindu mythology**, particularly the epic of the **Mahabharata**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eastern Ghats**__

 
 
• The **Eastern Ghats** run parallel to the eastern coast of India.
 
• They are lower in elevation compared to the **Western Ghats**.
 
• The Eastern Ghats are characterized by **discontinuous ranges** and hills.
 
• The **Eastern Ghats** spread across the Indian states of **Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka.**
